name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his father's garage. This hands-on experience sparked a lifelong passion for understanding the intricate mechanics of racing machines. After a brief stint as a junior mechanic, he transitioned into test driving, leveraging his innate ability to diagnose and communicate vehicle performance effectively. He's spent the last 15 years honing his expertise in karting, first as a test driver, and now as a coordinator.

Alistair's approach to test driver coordination is deeply rooted in fostering open communication between the drivers, engineers, and mechanics. He believes in detailed feedback and meticulous data analysis to optimize kart performance. His focus is on identifying subtle nuances in handling and translating them into actionable adjustments. 

Known for his meticulous nature and unwavering dedication, Alistair is a valuable asset to any racing team. While he may not be the loudest voice in the paddock, his experience and keen eye for detail make him a highly respected figure in the Tony Kart Racing organization. He's also known for his creative solutions to unusual problems.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly weathered face and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten technical diagrams.
Insists on drinking Earl Grey tea at precisely 10:00 AM every morning.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
